anti_overlap: Any media-ecology or medium-form seed lens from the prior run (fd-media-ecology-medium-bias, fd-place-authority-dissolution) covers HOW information is transmitted/what medium permits; this agent covers HOW objective events are FELT once received — a distinct mediating layer even where both could attach near public_opinion/epistemic_regime_blend

fd-societal-layer-gap-ranking (existing) owns the final cross-candidate ranking table; this agent supplies the experiential-regime candidate's evidence and cost estimate as an input, not a competing overall ranking
decision_lens: The sim has public_opinion, cultural_evolution, and ideology state, but per the inventory these are either symptom-level (satisfaction_by_quintile, polarization) or slow value-axes (tradition/innovation, collectivism/individualism) — none of them represent a MEDIATING layer that sits between a shock/pressure event and the population's felt/behavioral response to it. The Boddice-school claim is specifically that the SAME objective shock (a famine, a war casualty count, an economic contraction of a given magnitude) can produce wildly different unrest/legitimacy/polarization responses depending on the experiential regime a population currently occupies — and that this regime itself drifts across decades independent of the shocks it mediates. The test is whether any existing signal can vary the GAIN between a shock's objective magnitude and its pressure-space effect, holding the shock and all current pressures constant, or whether the model can only ever produce proportional response (bigger shock -> bigger effect, same ratio everywhere and everywhen).
focus: Whether the simulation models any experiential-regime layer that mediates between an objective event/shock and a population's FELT response — the Boddice-school claim that populations respond to felt events, not raw events, and that the experiential regime itself (emotional norms, sensory culture, thresholds of what counts as pain/threat/outrage) drifts independently over decades and differs by country
name: fd-experiential-regime-gap
persona: Apply the perspective of a history-of-experience/history-of-emotion researcher in the Rob Boddice tradition, synthesizing William Reddy's emotives (emotional expressions that both describe and constitute felt states, subject to an 'emotional regime' enforced by political authority), Barbara Rosenwein's emotional communities (groups sharing norms for which emotions are valued/expressed and how), sensory history (Alain Corbin, Mark Smith — historically variable thresholds for what counts as noxious, threatening, or intolerable sensory/bodily experience), and Boddice's own biocultural historicism of pain and sympathy (physiological response is itself culturally and historically shaped, not a fixed substrate onto which culture is merely layered).
review_areas: Whether any existing per-country signal (public_opinion's satisfaction_by_quintile/hypernormal_gap, cultural_evolution's core axes, or epistemic_regime_blend) functions as a response-GAIN modulator on shock/pressure conversion, as opposed to being itself just another additive pressure input parallel to the shock — i.e. can the model currently produce two countries with identical shock magnitudes and identical starting pressures but different unrest outcomes purely because of a differing 'how it felt' variable

Whether public_opinion's epistemic_regime_blend (oral/literate/broadcast/networked/secondary-oral mix, public_opinion/types.rs:471-475 per inventory §9) — the one existing 'regime' concept in the codebase — is a plausible host for an experiential-regime axis, or whether it's specifically an INFORMATION/media-consumption regime (how people receive information) rather than an EXPERIENTIAL regime (how people feel/interpret/embody what they receive), and whether conflating the two would misattribute Boddice-school findings to the wrong existing state

Whether shock magnitude-to-pressure conversion (shocks.rs, magnitudes 0.18-0.36 applied directly) has any modulation point where a per-country or per-era experiential-regime term could scale the conversion, versus requiring the shock-application code path itself to be rewritten

Whether legitimacy/unrest response to a given LegitimacyCrisis or SocialUnrest pressure LEVEL is uniformly interpreted (i.e. is 0.5 SocialUnrest always 'the same amount of unrest' regardless of country or era) or whether there's any latent per-country threshold-of-tolerance concept that could be surfaced as the experiential-regime host, distinguishing 'objectively equivalent pressure' from 'equivalently FELT pressure'

Whether cultural_evolution's slow drift (0.001-0.002/tick core/social axes, inventory §9) is a plausible host for experiential-regime drift specifically, given it already models decades-scale value change, or whether its four axes (tradition/innovation, collectivism/individualism, authority_acceptance, risk_tolerance) are structurally about VALUES rather than felt-experience/sensory-threshold shifts and would need a genuinely distinct axis

Whether a per-country experiential-regime term is better modeled as a coupling modulator on shock-to-pressure and pressure-to-unrest conversion (cheapest, B7-favored) or requires new additive per-country structural state analogous to StructuralProfile — and whether it should live at the shock-application layer, the cascade layer, or the legitimacy-response layer given each has different calibration-cost implications

severity_examples.condition: The defining Boddice-school claim — same event, different felt response depending on regime — is structurally inexpressible if the proposed state is downstream-only (another symptom) rather than upstream-modulating (a gain term on shock conversion)
severity_examples.scenario: A candidate design proposes an 'emotional regime' state that is really just a rename or thin wrapper of existing satisfaction_by_quintile or polarization fields, with no independent drift and no distinct modulating role on shock-to-pressure gain — i.e. it claims to model Boddice's felt-event mediation but never actually decouples the felt response's MAGNITUDE from the event's objective magnitude

severity_examples.condition: Risks silent double-counting or missing scope with the pace-layer/media-ecology candidates in this same portfolio if the two distinct mediating-layer claims aren't kept separate with distinct hosts
severity_examples.scenario: epistemic_regime_blend (an information-reception-modality mix) is proposed as the direct host for the experiential-regime axis without acknowledging that it currently governs how information is CONSUMED (oral vs. broadcast vs. networked), not how raw shock magnitude is FELT — conflating a Boddice/Reddy/Rosenwein sensory-and-emotional-norms claim with a McLuhan/media-ecology claim that a separate seed lens in this same run already covers

severity_examples.condition: The forcing-curve pattern (global, capacity-mediated, no per-country targeting) is the wrong template to copy for this specific candidate since cross-country variation in felt-response is the entire empirical content of the claim
severity_examples.scenario: A proposed experiential-regime axis is scoped as global (one blend for the whole world, like the forcing curves) rather than per-country, losing the specific Boddice/Rosenwein claim that emotional communities and sensory thresholds vary by population and era, not just by calendar year

success_hints: Reward a review that clearly identifies the missing mechanism as a GAIN/MODULATION term on shock-to-pressure and pressure-to-response conversion, not another additive state parallel to existing pressures — this is the specific structural signature of 'felt event mediates response'

Reward explicit disambiguation between an experiential/emotional-regime axis (Boddice/Reddy/Rosenwein/Corbin: how magnitude is felt) and epistemic_regime_blend/media-ecology (how information is received) as two distinct candidate mechanisms that should not collapse into one, even though both could plausibly attach near public_opinion

Reward identification of the cheapest viable host (coupling modulator on shock magnitude or cascade propagation_rate) versus more expensive hosts (new per-country structural axis, new pressure family), with a stated calibration-cost estimate for the f-007 ranking table

Reward naming which specific historical dynamics become expressible (a shock of identical objective magnitude producing collapse in one experiential regime/era and stability in another, given otherwise-identical StructuralProfile/pressure state) as the concrete success criterion
Penalize proposals that treat this axis as simply 'more public opinion detail' without engaging the specific claim that felt magnitude can diverge from objective magnitude
task_context: What societal-dynamics layers and world systems is shadow-work missing? Mandated seed axes: Brand pace-layering (layer-speed stratification and shearing), institutional dynamics (lifecycle, capture, trust, elite overproduction — North/Ostrom/Turchin), and history of experience/emotion/the senses (Boddice school: experiential regimes mediating between event and felt response). Keep the portfolio-ranking mandate live throughout: every candidate layer must name a concrete code host and a calibration-cost estimate under B7 discipline, feeding the f-007 ranking table. Comparators in scope: finance/credit contagion, public health, energy, organized crime, religion, education.
